Beginner.learningGoal: Filter, project, sort and aggregate in-memory collections with LINQ method syntax instead of hand-written loops.
gotchas: First() throws on an empty sequence; FirstOrDefault() returns default instead
OrderBy followed by OrderBy discards the first ordering; ThenBy is needed
Sum/Average on an empty sequence of nullable vs non-nullable values behave differently
goodSolutionShows: The right terminal operator (Any vs Count() > 0, FirstOrDefault vs First)
No unnecessary ToList() in the middle of a chain
shapeHints: summarising a list of orders by customer
filtering push notifications by status and date

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use grouping, joining and set operators, and understand deferred execution.
gotchas: Enumerating an IEnumerable twice re-runs the query (and any side effects)
GroupBy keys with reference types need proper equality
Distinct/Union on records vs classes compare differently
A query built inside a loop captures the variable, not its value at that time
goodSolutionShows: Materialising once (ToList/ToArray) when the result is enumerated more than once
Join or GroupJoin instead of nested loops
shapeHints: finding duplicates by a composite key
building a lookup of tenants to feature flags

Advanced.learningGoal: Write custom LINQ-style extension operators with iterators and reason about laziness and allocation.
gotchas: Argument validation inside an iterator method is deferred until enumeration
Disposing the source enumerator when stopping early
Buffering operators (OrderBy, Reverse) vs streaming ones
goodSolutionShows: Eager argument validation with a separate iterator method
Streaming implementation that works on infinite sequences where possible
Correct use of yield return / yield break
shapeHints: a Batch/Chunk-like operator with a size limit
a DistinctBy-style operator with a comparer
